tex_content.html:
Definition
[Running cost, terminal cost, and the cost functional] ↗ def:controlled-ode-admissible-controls 1. ch10:10.3-def-2\group Control Theory

For $x\in \R ^n$, $0\leq t\leq T$, and $\alpha \in \mathcal A$, define \[ C_{x,t}[\alpha (\cdot )] := \int _t^T h(\mathbf x(s), \alpha (s)) \, ds + g(\mathbf x(T)), \tag {4} \] where $\mathbf x=\mathbf x^{\alpha (\cdot )}$ solves (1). The running and terminal costs \[ h : \R ^n \times A \to \R , \quad g : \R ^n \to \R \] are bounded and Lipschitz uniformly in $a$: \[ \begin{cases} |h(x, a)|, |g(x)| \le C \\ |h(x, a) - h(y, a)|, |g(x) - g(y)| \le C|x - y| \end{cases} \quad (x, y \in \R ^n, a \in A) \tag {5} \] for some $C$.
